record.title: SocraticPO injects targeted natural-language teacher guidance into RL rollouts
record.summary: SocraticPO changes the rollout stage of LLM reinforcement learning: a student first answers independently, a teacher supplies concise corrective guidance only after failure, and successful recovery receives a decayed reward so the policy cannot treat teacher intervention as a free shortcut.
organizations: University of Science and Technology of China

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: SocraticPO conditionally gives teacher feedback after an incorrect student attempt and applies decayed reward to teacher-assisted success.

claims.label: CLAIMED
claims.text: The authors report improvements over their RL and self-distillation baselines on SciKnowEval scientific reasoning tasks.

engineering_implications: Can be layered over existing policy-gradient backends because the teacher operates through text and rollout context rather than optimizer-specific internals.

evidence_gaps.description: No matched total-compute study establishes whether SocraticPO beats spending the same extra teacher/GPU budget on more ordinary RL rollouts or offline synthetic supervision.
Independent evidence across larger students and non-science domains is missing.

limitations: Evidence is concentrated on a 4B student and undergraduate scientific reasoning tasks; transfer to coding, agents, long-horizon reasoning or larger models is not established.
Teacher inference consumes two of six H100s in the reported setup, so quality gains are not separated from added teacher-compute budget.
A stronger teacher may provide latent answer information even when prompted for guidance; robustness to teacher quality and leakage needs broader controls.
organizations: University of Science and Technology of China
research_implications: Outcome-only RL need not be the only practical option if natural-language corrective signals can be integrated without teacher logits.
Reward shaping for assisted trajectories is a key control variable: without a penalty, the student may learn dependence on the teacher rather than independent repair.
brief.summary: SocraticPO changes the rollout stage of LLM reinforcement learning: a student first answers independently, a teacher supplies concise corrective guidance only after failure, and successful recovery receives a decayed reward so the policy cannot treat teacher intervention as a free shortcut.

technical.claimed_result: Authors report that SocraticPO improves over their RL and self-distillation baselines and argue that natural-language correction can serve as process-level supervision without teacher distribution matching.
technical.compute_or_cost: Teacher inference adds material rollout cost and hardware occupancy; the paper does not establish a matched total-training-cost Pareto advantage.
technical.demonstrated_result: The preprint documents experiments with Qwen3-4B-Instruct students on SciKnowEval-style undergraduate scientific reasoning tasks, using Reinforce++, GRPO and self-distillation baselines, and reports ablations of targeted guidance and reward decay.
technical.implementation_status: Paper links a public GitHub repository and provides implementation hyperparameters; independent reproduction is not established in this record.
technical.mechanism: Conditional teacher intervention during on-policy rollout plus reward decay for teacher-assisted corrections; the expected-reward objective can remain unchanged.
technical.novelty: Moves corrective natural-language guidance inside RL rollout while explicitly discounting assisted successes, rather than using only scalar reward or full teacher-distribution distillation.
technical.regime: 4B student; teacher is either Qwen3-4B-Instruct or Qwen3.5-27B; six H100 GPUs total in the reported implementation, with four for student training and two for online teacher inference.
technical.reproducibility: Architecture and training recipe are described and code is linked; external replication and broader-task validation remain open.
technical.strongest_baseline: Qwen3-4B-Instruct runs with Reinforce++, GRPO and SDPO/self-distillation under the paper's reported settings.

brief.title: SocraticPO injects targeted natural-language teacher guidance into RL rollouts
brief.why_it_matters: It is a concrete route from outcome-only RL toward process-level supervision without requiring teacher logits or distribution matching. The mechanism can use black-box teachers, making it practical for smaller open students, but its evidence is still narrow and teacher-compute intensive.
